# Flex

Create a flexbox container and transform direct children elements into flex items.<br />
Flex containers and items are able to be modified further with additional flex properties.

<Canvas of={FlexStories.Basic} />

```css
.bd-warmgrey-50 {
  border: solid 1px #c5d3db;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

## Examples

#### Direction

| Class name        | Usage                              |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| ds-row            | distribute flex items horizontally |
| ds-column         | distribute flex items vertically   |
| ds-row-reverse    | reverse row ordering               |
| ds-column-reverse | reverse col ordering               |

#### Justify content

Alignment of flex items on the **main axis** (x-axis for row, y-axis for column).

| Class name                       | Usage                                    |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| ds-justify-content-start         | align items at start of the direction    |
| ds-justify-content-center        | align items at center                    |
| ds-justify-content-end           | align items at end of the direction      |
| ds-justify-content-space-between | fill space between items                 |
| ds-justify-content-space-around  | add space around items                   |
| ds-justify-content-space-evenly  | add equal space between and around items |

#### Align items

Alignment of flex items on the **cross axis** (y-axis for column, x-axis for row).

| Class name              | Usage                                     |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| ds-align-items-start    | align items at start of the cross axis    |
| ds-align-items-center   | align items at center                     |
| ds-align-items-end      | align items at end of the cross axis      |
| ds-align-items-baseline | align items at the items content baseline |
| ds-align-items-stretch  | stretch items on the cross axis           |

#### Align self

**Individual** Alignment of flex items on the **cross axis** (y-axis for column, x-axis for row).

| Class name             | Usage                                               |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| ds-align-self-start    | align individual item at start of the cross axis    |
| ds-align-self-center   | align individual item at center                     |
| ds-align-self-end      | align individual item at end of the cross axis      |
| ds-align-self-baseline | align individual item at the items content baseline |
| ds-align-self-stretch  | stretch individual item on the cross axis           |

#### Align content

Alignment of flex items together on the **cross axis** (y-axis for column, x-axis for row).<br />
(has no effect when the flexbox has only a single line)

| Class name                     | Usage                                           |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------- |
| ds-align-content-start         | align lines of items at start of the cross axis |
| ds-align-content-center        | align lines of items at center                  |
| ds-align-content-end           | align lines of items at end of the cross axis   |
| ds-align-content-space-between | fill space between lines of items               |
| ds-align-content-space-around  | add space around lines of items                 |
| ds-align-content-stretch       | stretch lines of items                          |
